proposed_widenings.name: soul_vessel
proposed_widenings.justification: Clone creates a biological duplicate that serves as a passive soul-backup vessel — not a controlled companion (no command relationship), not an anchored alarm (no location anchor, no area trigger), not a spawned creature. The clone is inert until the original's death, at which point a soul-transfer event fires. No existing family (ongoing_effect / activation / triggered_reaction / anchored_trigger / spawned_creature / reanimated_creature) can honestly model this shape.
proposed_widenings.evidence: An inert duplicate of that creature forms inside the vessel... If the original creature dies after the clone finishes forming, the creature's soul transfers to the clone if the soul is free and willing to return.

proposed_widenings.name: CastingTime.hours
proposed_widenings.justification: Clone's casting time is 1 hour. The surface only has CastingTime.minutes (for long-cast spells like Alarm). No hours variant exists.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger / AnchoredEvent: on_creature_dies
proposed_widenings.justification: The soul transfer fires when the original creature dies. This is not in the OngoingTrigger or AnchoredEvent vocabulary (which only covers turn-start, attack-hit, damage-taken, creature-enters-area, etc.). A 'creature dies' event is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If the original creature dies after the clone finishes forming, the creature's soul transfers to the clone...

proposed_widenings.name: soul_transfer
proposed_widenings.justification: The mechanic of transferring a creature's soul to a prepared vessel on death — carrying personality, memories, and abilities — is not representable as any existing EffectAtom. It is not transform_target (that replaces stats), not create_companion (no control relationship), not apply_condition, not heal_hp.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The creature's soul transfers to the clone if the soul is free and willing to return. The clone is physically identical to the original and has the same personality, memories, and abilities...

proposed_widenings.name: block_reanimation_of_original
proposed_widenings.justification: The original's remains become permanently inert and cannot be revived. This is stronger than the existing block_reanimation atom (which gates the reanimation family from targeting the corpse) — here the original body is rendered permanently non-revivable because the soul is elsewhere. This overlaps with block_reanimation but the RAW text distinguishes 'can't be revived' from 'can't become Undead'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The creature's original remains, if any, become inert and can't be revived, since the creature's soul is elsewhere.

proposed_widenings.name: delayed_growth_timer
proposed_widenings.justification: The clone 'finishes growing after 120 days' — a fixed elapsed-time delay before the vessel becomes a valid soul-transfer target. No existing timer atom models a 'not yet ready' state on a created object. PassiveOperation.elapsed_time is for item-worn periodic effects, not a one-shot readiness gate.
proposed_widenings.evidence: An inert duplicate of that creature forms inside the vessel... and finishes growing after 120 days.

notes: Clone has no honest encoding in any existing family. The soul-vessel pattern (inert biological duplicate + death-triggered soul transfer + original rendered inert) is a distinct semantic family not present in the surface. Additionally: (1) casting time 'hours' is missing from CastingTime; (2) 'soul is free and willing' is DM agenda and cannot be modeled deterministically; (3) the 120-day growth delay has no timer primitive. Six separate gaps compound to make this a clear structural_widening. No dhall/json/trace produced.
